task.title: Opening Apps
task.shortdesc: To open an App, you must be connected to your instance.

step.cmd: Click Apps and then click Open Application to view the available Apps to open.
Either scroll down to find an App or enter in the App name in Search by Application Name and click Search. Then either double-click on the App or click Select.

note.p: The My Apps check box is an App designer option only for testing apps.

step.cmd: You can also select an App from the shortcut list.

postreq.p: After the App loads into Excel, you will see custom menus created specifically for the chosen app, such as Retrieve Opportunities, as well as one or more of the X-Author for Excel standard buttons: Add Row, Paste, Delete Row(s) from your environment.
